title: Goodwill Schedule for Late Hosting Provisioning — Harborline Customer Accounts
content:
# Goodwill schedule for late hosting provisioning

**Product:** Harborline Customer Accounts

Harborline's published goodwill schedule for late hosting provisioning credits goodwill to the account, without the customer having to ask, for the hosting plan of the customer's most recent initial-term charge when that plan, active and in its first term, was activated late after its order date. The goodwill it grants is a Harborline service-failure goodwill credit on the customer's account credit.

## Conditions of the grant

- Goodwill credit may be granted only while the account status is active.
- One grant may be made per affected holding or charge reference.
- The grant is posted against the order number of the plan's initial-term charge, with hosting as the affected category.
- Where the amount the schedule yields is zero, nothing is owed under this schedule and no entry is posted.

## Recording the grant

The goodwill is recorded with the agent-side tool `grant_provisioning_goodwill_e1bd747b`. Unlock it first and then call it; it is run by the agent, not handed to the customer. One call records one goodwill credit on the customer's Harborline account credit, posted against the order number of the plan's initial-term charge with hosting as the affected product: the account credit balance goes up by the goodwill amount and the goodwill appears on the account's credit history at once, spendable on any Harborline product and never withdrawable.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `account_id` | The reference number of the customer's Harborline account, as shown on the account record opened for this customer. | Identifier, as shown on the record |
| `source_charge_ref` | The order number of the hosting plan's initial-term charge, HL- followed by 8 digits, as shown on the hosting billing history. | Reference exactly as shown on the record; the empty string is not used |
| `amount` | The goodwill credited, in US dollars. | A positive figure with 2 decimal places; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent |

## What the call returns

A completed call returns a confirmation line beginning "Goodwill credited", stating the reference number of the new goodwill entry, the amount credited in US dollars with two decimals, the reference it was posted against and the account's new credit balance in US dollars with two decimals.

The call is refused with an error line when `amount` is not a positive US dollar figure, or when `source_charge_ref` is not an order number made of HL- followed by 8 digits.
